clue.text: Some slumber therein

indicators.note: some of the following words means only a part of their letters is taken, running across the gap between them

explanation.surface: A remark about a bed or bunk where a few people sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the letters sit inside 'slumber therein', and the answer is a place where some people slumber.
explanation.definitionFit: A bunk on a ship or train is the bed in which a traveller sleeps.

clue.text: Support objection over lock

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so the objection comes first

parts.note: but is a word for an objection, as in no ifs or buts
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone backs an objection raised about a lock of hair or a door.
explanation.definitionFit: A projecting structure that props up a wall is a support, and the word is also a verb for reinforcing.

clue.text: Way to completely defeat English

parts.note: to rout is to defeat utterly

explanation.surface: A strategy for crushing the English.
explanation.definitionFit: A path or course taken to get somewhere is a synonym for way.

clue.text: How we are told to eat the hay I'll put out

definitions.text: How we are told to eat

indicators.note: put out means disturbed or dislodged, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for eating hay set out in the field, as if for animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Health advice tells us to eat in a wholesome way, so the adverb describes the manner of eating.

clue.text: Outburst of anger that may become inflated?

definitions.meaning: a sudden loss of temper, a row
something you can ..., like a balloon or a paddling pool, is filled with air

explanation.surface: A temper tantrum compared to something swelling with air.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden row is a synonym in noun form, and an inflatable item is one designed to be filled with air.

clue.text: Left a key for scientists' workroom

parts.note: B is a musical key

explanation.surface: Someone left a key behind for the scientists' room.
explanation.definitionFit: A laboratory, shortened, is the room where scientists do experiments.

clue.text: Turns round outside of our royal castle

parts.note: to wind is to turn round and round, as a road or a handle does

indicators.note: the outside of the word our is its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone turns about outside a castle belonging to the monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: The castle in Berkshire, west of London, is one of the main homes of the British monarch.

clue.text: Container for plant around large garden area?

indicators.note: the plant container goes round the letter for large

parts.note: a pot is what a plant grows in

explanation.surface: A big flowerpot placed out in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: A small piece of ground for growing vegetables is a typical part of a garden, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Claim Greens disrupted output from dairy

indicators.note: disrupted means thrown into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Environmental campaigners claim to have disrupted a dairy's production.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin pouring cream is one of the products a dairy makes.

clue.text: Giant wave — in it chap in front of us gets swept over

indicators.note: something swept over is turned right round, so the whole assembled string is read backwards
the chap and us are placed inside the word it
the man is placed before the word us

parts.note: a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A huge sea wave sweeps over a man standing ahead of a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts MANUS inside IT, giving IMANUST; 'gets swept over' then turns that string backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A very large sea wave caused by an earthquake is the standard sense of this Japanese loanword.

clue.text: Hollow ringing sound found with old drum

parts.note: a bong is the deep resonant sound of a bell or gong

explanation.surface: A deep, hollow noise produced by an ancient drum.
explanation.definitionFit: A small hand drum played in pairs with the fingers is a well-known percussion instrument of this name.

clue.text: You once got attached to right sort of whisky

indicators.note: the old word for you is fixed onto the right-hand letter, so it follows it

parts.note: ye is the old form of you

explanation.surface: In old times someone took up with the right kind of whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Whisky distilled mainly from rye grain is a North American style, so this is an example of a kind.

clue.text: Irish get upset and fierce-tempered

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disordered, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Irish people get upset and turn bad-tempered.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving like a big cat that attacks is a synonym for being fierce and aggressive.

clue.text: Tries cutting material in run-through of play

indicators.note: the word for tries cuts into the word for material, so it sits inside it

parts.note: real and material both mean physically existing
a judge hears or tries a case

explanation.surface: Someone tries cutting cloth during a practice for a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice performance of a stage play before opening night is the theatre sense.

clue.text: Tie is no longer important and the opposite of cool

parts.note: an issue that is dead no longer matters
heat is warmth, the opposite of coolness

explanation.surface: A dull remark that a necktie is passe and far from cool.
explanation.definitionFit: A race in which two finish exactly level is the noun sense of a tie.

clue.text: Perhaps tennis player's run up part of restaurant bill

definitions.meaning: a tennis player may serve and then charge forward to the net, a charge after service
an extra percentage added to a restaurant bill for the staff

explanation.surface: A tennis player's dash is set beside a line item on a restaurant bill.
explanation.definitionFit: Restaurants often add a fixed tip line to the bill, and in tennis the serve is followed by a rush forward.

clue.text: Cheese on toast a little undercooked?

parts.note: rare meat is lightly cooked
a bit is a little

explanation.surface: A bit of grilled cheese on toast that is slightly underdone.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit is a dish of melted, seasoned cheese on toast.

clue.text: Ill-defined item, eg a rare uncertainty finally resolved

indicators.note: resolved here means taken apart and worked out anew, so these letters are rearranged
finally takes only the closing letter of the word uncertainty

explanation.surface: Something vague, like a rare doubt, is finally settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' rearranges EGARARE plus Y, the end of 'uncertainty'. 'uncertainty' looks like the definition but only supplies a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter that falls between clear categories is an idiom for something vague or not clearly defined.

clue.text: Said when one leaves in low spirits

indicators.note: one departing the word said means that numeral's letter is removed from it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone said they felt down when another person left.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unhappy or downcast is a direct synonym for being in low spirits.

clue.text: A lass dancing — this?

indicators.note: dancing letters move about, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl on the dance floor, and what she might be performing.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: a girl dancing may be doing this Latin dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively Latin American dance is something a girl could be dancing.

clue.text: I dare dropping king's flag

indicators.note: dropping means the king letter is left out

parts.note: to risk is to dare
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A boast that one dares to lower the king's standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flag' looks like a banner, but here it is the plant: yellow flag is a wild iris.
explanation.definitionFit: Flag is a plant name for a wild species of this flower, with sword-shaped leaves.

clue.text: Automaton, British in origin

indicators.note: British goes inside the word for origin

parts.note: a root is the source or origin of something

explanation.surface: A mechanical man said to have been invented in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that acts on its own in imitation of a person is a synonym for automaton.

clue.text: Sailor from Costa Rica

indicators.note: from here means the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A seaman who comes from Costa Rica.
explanation.definitionFit: Jack tar is old slang for a seaman, from the tarred clothing and rigging of sailing ships.

clue.text: A bishop has to work out a puzzle free from guilt

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop
to solve is to work out a puzzle

explanation.surface: A bishop must crack a riddle before being declared innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: To pardon or clear someone of sin is the verb sense, matching the phrase meaning release from blame.

clue.text: Took a seat with anger for humorous play

parts.note: sat is the past tense of sit, to take a seat
ire is a literary word for anger

explanation.surface: An audience member sat down angrily to watch a comedy.
explanation.definitionFit: A work that ridicules folly through humour, such as a mocking play, is the literary genre meant here.

clue.text: Smallest area cuts half of that?

indicators.note: area slices into the middle of the other word, so it goes inside it

parts.note: that points back to the definition, smallest; its second half, the last four of its eight letters, is lest

explanation.surface: The tiniest region removes half of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that' refers back to 'Smallest', whose back half is LEST; 'cuts' puts A (area) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of little, meaning of the lowest amount, is a synonym for smallest.
